description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the collection.

> You can call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to query a list of collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
命名空间。

> 您通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The namespace name.

> You can call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

> The value of this parameter is specified when you call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en:
The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. This parameter and DBInstanceId cannot both be empty. If both parameters are specified, this value takes precedence.

Valid values:

*   ip
*   l2
*   cosine

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-index --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --collection testcollection --index-name testindex --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeIndex --region cn-hangzhou --IndexName testindex --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Collection testcollection --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
